selection_design: frozen outcome-first design; 64 Q1, 48 Q2-only and 48 Q3-only source/ID records; source/ID selection is not efficacy ranking
limitations: One root reader only; independent lane review remains pending.
Eligibility routing is not compound efficacy appraisal or BUB1B/MVA evidence.
Selected source/ID records are not unique molecules, trials or cohorts; versions and reports require deduplication.

records.title: A controlled trial of amino acid therapy in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: I. Clinical, functional, and maximum isometric torque data.
records.role: BCAA or L-threonine in ALS controlled trial
records.population_preparation_and_design: Two-center double-blind placebo-controlled 6-month trial; 95 randomized to BCAA, L-threonine plus pyridoxal phosphate, or placebo; 77 completed.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Strength, isometric torque, FVC, activities of daily living and timed tasks; no functional or torque benefit, while FVC decline was greater in active groups.
records.uncertainty: High attrition and possible pulmonary harm signal; mixture/component and disease-specific limits.

records.title: The effect on knee-joint load of instruction in analgesic use compared with neuromuscular exercise in patients with knee osteoarthritis: study protocol for a randomized, single-blind, controlled trial (the EXERPHARMA trial).
records.role: Protocol for knee OA exercise versus analgesic advice
records.population_preparation_and_design: Randomized single-blind EXERPHARMA trial protocol comparing neuromuscular exercise with instruction in analgesic use.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Planned pain and joint-load outcomes; no results in this report.
records.uncertainty: Protocol-only; no compound efficacy.

records.title: A randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind phase IIb trial evaluating the safety and efficacy of tirasemtiv in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 596 adults randomized after open-label tolerability lead-in to tirasemtiv or placebo for 12 weeks.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: ALSFRS-R primary endpoint was null; secondary SVC and muscle-strength decline favored treatment.
records.uncertainty: Primary failure, enriched tolerator randomization, more dropouts/serious adverse events on active treatment.

records.title: Creatine monohydrate in DM2/PROMM: a double-blind placebo-controlled clinical study. Proximal myotonic myopathy.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 20 patients randomized double-blind to creatine or placebo for three months.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Hand-held dynamometry, grip, MRC score and symptom score showed no significant between-group difference.
records.uncertainty: Small trial with only trend-level signals; no demonstrated functional benefit.

records.title: What Nutraceuticals Can Do for Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy: Lessons Learned from Amino Acid Supplementation in Mouse Models.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Narrative review of amino acid/derivative supplementation across DMD mouse models.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Summarizes muscle injury, strength and endurance results; no new intervention cohort.
records.uncertainty: Preclinical review, not a new trial or human efficacy result.

records.title: Randomized, Controlled Trial of the Effect of Dietary Potassium Restriction on Nerve Function in CKD.
records.role: Dietary potassium restriction and nerve function in CKD
records.population_preparation_and_design: 47 stage 3–4 CKD patients randomized single-blind to potassium-restricted diet or general nutrition advice for 24 months; rescue sodium polystyrene sulfonate allowed.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Primary neurologic/nerve-function outcome rather than muscle output.
records.uncertainty: Diet plus possible rescue drug complicates attribution; renal/neuropathy context, no BUB1B rationale.

records.title: Skeletal muscle twitch relaxation kinetics following heat stress endurance: carbohydrate versus placebo.
records.role: Carbohydrate format after cycling in heat
records.population_preparation_and_design: Ten trained male cyclists completed five randomized Latin-square conditions, including carbohydrate beverage/capsules and placebo formats.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Cycling performance and twitch/neuromuscular measures assessed; no difference in time or task failure.
records.uncertainty: Small sport-physiology study; format-specific comparisons and no disease transfer.

records.title: Sodium Bicarbonate Supplementation Delays Neuromuscular Fatigue Without Changes in Performance Outcomes During a Basketball Match Simulation Protocol.
records.role: Sodium bicarbonate and fatigue in basketball simulation
records.population_preparation_and_design: Ten participants ingested sodium bicarbonate or equimolar sodium chloride placebo before a simulated match.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Knee-extensor twitch fatigue and basketball performance measures assessed; fatigue delay did not translate into better performance outcomes.
records.uncertainty: Very small athletic study; distinguish neuromuscular fatigue from actual game performance.

records.title: Effectiveness of oral motor interventions on feeding and orofacial motor outcomes in preterm infants: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
records.role: Oral motor interventions in preterm infants systematic review
records.population_preparation_and_design: Systematic review/meta-analysis of randomized oral-motor interventions in preterm infants.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Feeding/orofacial motor outcomes, not skeletal muscle treatment.
records.uncertainty: Review of training/device approaches, not a compound candidate.

records.title: New Strategy That Delays Progression of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis in G1H-G93A Transgenic Mice: Oral Administration of Xanthine Oxidoreductase Inhibitors That Are Not Substrates for the Purine Salvage Pathway.
records.role: Xanthine oxidoreductase inhibitors in ALS mice
records.population_preparation_and_design: G1H-G93A SOD1 mice treated orally with four XOR inhibitors from day 80.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Three non-purine inhibitors improved clinical signs and motor tests and delayed disease; allopurinol did not.
records.uncertainty: Mouse model, gene-specific ALS pathology; no human or BUB1B/MVA evidence.

records.title: A double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized trial of PXT3003 for the treatment of Charcot-Marie-Tooth type 1A.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 323 adults with mild/moderate CMT1A randomized to two oral combination doses or placebo for up to 15 months.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: High-dose group improved primary ONLS versus placebo (−0.37 points; 97.5% CI −0.68 to −0.06; p=.008).
records.uncertainty: High-dose arm stopped early after crystal formation; SAP changed before database lock and modified full-analysis set used. Fixed combination, no component attribution.

records.title: Evaluation of therapeutic electrical stimulation to improve muscle strength and function in children with types II/III spinal muscular atrophy.
records.role: Therapeutic electrical stimulation in pediatric SMA
records.population_preparation_and_design: Randomized within-child-arm trial of nighttime electrical stimulation versus placebo stimulator in 13 children with SMA; eight completed.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Arm strength/function and excitable muscle mass measured; no significant treatment-control differences.
records.uncertainty: Device intervention, not a compound; small sample and attrition.

records.title: Balanced Free Essential Amino Acids and Resistance Exercise Training Synergistically Improve Dexamethasone-Induced Impairments in Muscle Strength, Endurance, and Insulin Sensitivity in Mice.
records.role: Essential amino acids plus resistance exercise in dexamethasone-treated mice
records.population_preparation_and_design: Mice assigned to control, EAA, resistance exercise or combined EAA/exercise during dexamethasone exposure.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Muscle strength, endurance, insulin sensitivity and tissue measures assessed.
records.uncertainty: Preclinical drug-induced atrophy model; combination effects must be separated; no MVA.

records.title: Treatments for chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyradiculoneuropathy (CIDP): an overview of systematic reviews.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Overview of prior systematic reviews of therapies for chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyradiculoneuropathy.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Reviews disability, walking and other outcomes; no new trial.
records.uncertainty: Secondary evidence only; autoimmune neuropathy context.

records.title: Neostigmine Administration after Spontaneous Recovery to a Train-of-Four Ratio of 0.9 to 1.0: A Randomized Controlled Trial of the Effect on Neuromuscular and Clinical Recovery.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 90 surgical patients with train-of-four ≥0.9 randomized to neostigmine 40 μg/kg or saline after rocuronium.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Neuromuscular recovery and muscle strength compared; postoperative clinical recovery monitored.
records.uncertainty: Perioperative reversal context, not a therapeutic muscle-rescue candidate.

records.title: Effects of carbohydrate availability on cycling endurance at the maximal lactate steady state.
records.role: Carbohydrate loading and cycling endurance at MLSS
records.population_preparation_and_design: Ten adults in blinded placebo-controlled cycling protocol with carbohydrate drinks and glycogen-depleting exercise conditions.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Time to task failure did not improve with carbohydrate loading; glycogen-depleted conditions shortened it.
records.uncertainty: Small exercise study; acute nutrition and protocol-specific effects.

records.title: Ascorbate attenuates cycling exercise-induced neuromuscular fatigue but fails to improve exertional dyspnea and exercise tolerance in COPD.
records.role: Intravenous ascorbate and exercise in COPD
records.population_preparation_and_design: Eight COPD patients completed saline/2 g IV vitamin C conditions with cycling to task failure and isotime trials.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Vitamin C attenuated quadriceps neuromuscular fatigue but did not improve exertional dyspnea or exercise tolerance.
records.uncertainty: Tiny mechanistic crossover; fatigue is not a demonstrated useful-performance gain.

records.title: Efficacy of intradialytic neuromuscular electrical stimulation and oral nutritional supplementation in hemodialysis patients: a multicenter, randomized controlled trial.
records.role: Protein supplementation and intradialytic NMES in hemodialysis
records.population_preparation_and_design: 12-week multicenter randomized trial with control, protein, NMES and combination arms; 59 completed.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Grip and leg strength did not differ by group; gait improved in NMES arms, with selected QoL and high-intensity NMES subgroup effects.
records.uncertainty: Protein-specific effect not established; NMES cointervention accounts for the task gains.

records.title: Creatine supplementation and exercise in aging: a narrative review of the muscle-brain axis and its impact on cognitive and physical health.
records.role: Creatine and exercise in aging narrative review
records.population_preparation_and_design: Narrative review of creatine plus exercise and the muscle-brain axis in older adults.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Summarizes prior trial results; no new cohort.
records.uncertainty: Review only; underlying primary trials must be assessed separately.

records.title: Immunosuppressant and immunomodulatory treatment for dermatomyositis and polymyositis.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Systematic review of randomized/quasi-randomized immunosuppressant and immunomodulatory trials in inflammatory myopathy.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Reviews strength/function outcomes; no new intervention cohort.
records.uncertainty: Review-level source in distinct autoimmune muscle diseases.

records.title: Efficacy Confirmation Study of Aceneuramic Acid Administration for GNE Myopathy in Japan
records.role: Aceneuramic acid extended-release in GNE myopathy
records.population_preparation_and_design: Phase 3 randomized double-blind multicenter comparison; only 14 participants enrolled, 10 active and 4 placebo, over 48 weeks.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Upper-extremity composite strength primary; active-minus-placebo difference +2.51 kg (95% CI −1.72 to 6.74), imprecise and compatible with no effect.
records.uncertainty: Severe arm imbalance and tiny placebo group make the estimate highly uncertain; preprint record and disease-specific replacement mechanism.

records.title: Safety, Tolerability, and Efficacy of Viltolarsen in Boys With Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy Amenable to Exon 53 Skipping: A Phase 2 Randomized Clinical Trial.
records.role: Viltolarsen in exon-53 amenable pediatric DMD
records.population_preparation_and_design: 16 boys received weekly IV viltolarsen after a 4-week randomized safety period; subsequent 20-week functional phase was open label.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Timed function and 6-minute walk improved versus external natural-history controls.
records.uncertainty: No concurrent placebo functional contrast; very small cohort, short follow-up and selected external comparator.

records.title: Effect of whey vs. soy protein supplementation on recovery kinetics following speed endurance training in competitive male soccer players: a randomized controlled trial.
records.role: Whey versus soy protein after soccer speed-endurance training
records.population_preparation_and_design: Ten trained male soccer players completed randomized double-blind crossover of whey, soy or maltodextrin placebo with different total-protein targets.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Field performance, recovery kinetics, muscle damage and redox measures assessed after training.
records.uncertainty: Unequal protein background in placebo and tiny athletic cohort limit nutrient attribution and disease transfer.

records.title: Bioavailability of Edaravone Sublingual Tablet Versus Intravenous Infusion in Healthy Male Volunteers.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Ten healthy men in randomized two-way crossover of 30 mg sublingual edaravone versus IV infusion.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Pharmacokinetic bioavailability/exposure comparison only; no clinical muscle function outcome.
records.uncertainty: Exposure bridging study, not efficacy evidence.

records.title: l-Arginine and Beetroot Extract Supplementation in the Prevention of Sarcopenia.
records.role: Arginine or beetroot extract with training in older adults
records.population_preparation_and_design: 66 older adults randomized double-blind to placebo, L-arginine or beetroot extract during six weeks of training.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: No strength, endurance or SPPB benefit; one male sprint-time signal and sex-specific biomarkers reported.
records.uncertainty: Small groups and multiple subgroup/biomarker outcomes; preserve main functional null.

records.title: Creatine supplementation attenuates the rate of fatigue development during intermittent isometric exercise performed above end-test torque.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Creatine/placebo supplementation compared during intermittent isometric knee-extensor exercise in healthy participants.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Creatine increased torque impulse above end-test torque and attenuated voluntary-activation and twitch decline.
records.uncertainty: Acute exercise physiology in healthy participants; does not demonstrate chronic muscle-disease benefit.

records.title: Effect of New Zealand Blackcurrant Supplementation on Sports Performance: A Systematic Review.
records.role: New Zealand blackcurrant performance systematic review
records.population_preparation_and_design: Systematic review/meta-analysis of 21 randomized crossover sports trials.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Synthesizes adult athletic performance and metabolic outcomes; no new intervention cohort.
records.uncertainty: Review-level, sport-specific context only.

records.title: Two-year efficacy and safety of risdiplam in patients with type 2 or non-ambulant type 3 spinal muscular atrophy (SMA).
records.population_preparation_and_design: Participants from a 12-month placebo-controlled SUNFISH trial continued risdiplam through month 24; external comparator used for longer-term estimates.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: MFM32 improvement/stabilization reported at two years.
records.uncertainty: Month-24 results are open-label extension/external comparison; retain the initial randomized 12-month result as the controlled contrast.

records.title: The use of creatine supplements in the military.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Narrative critical review of military creatine studies.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Summarizes prior training/fitness studies; no new trial cohort.
records.uncertainty: Secondary review, not an independent efficacy trial.

records.title: Effects of Curcumin and Fenugreek Soluble Fiber on the Physical Working Capacity at the Fatigue Threshold, Peak Oxygen Consumption, and Time to Exhaustion.
records.role: Curcumin plus fenugreek fibre or fenugreek alone in exercise test
records.population_preparation_and_design: 47 untrained college-aged adults randomized to placebo, curcumin+fenugreek or fenugreek for 28 days.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Fatigue-threshold power favored combination over placebo; VO2peak and time-to-exhaustion did not differ.
records.uncertainty: Small healthy cohort and combination formulation; ingredient-specific curcumin effect is not isolated.

records.title: Microencapsulated docosahexaenoic acid increases the Omega-3 Index and attenuates the physiological impact of eccentric exercise in physically trained adults: a 12-week double-blind placebo-controlled trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 38 trained adults completed 12-week double-blind comparison of 715 mg/day DHA or high-oleic acid control.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Secondary jump height/peak force at 48 hours after eccentric challenge favored DHA; primary outcomes were soreness and omega-3 index.
records.uncertainty: Unequal completed allocation (12 control/26 DHA), primary endpoints are not direct function and acute recovery is not chronic strength gain.

records.title: Mechanographic analyses in pediatrics: allometric scaling of 'peak jump force' and its relationship to 'maximal isometric grip force' in childhood and adolescence.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Observational force-scaling analysis in children/adolescents and congenital-heart-disease context; no compound assignment.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Relates jump/grip force to anthropometry.
records.uncertainty: Measurement/scaling context only.

records.title: Low-level laser therapy improves the VO<sub>2</sub> kinetics in competitive cyclists.
records.role: Low-level laser therapy and cyclist VO2 kinetics
records.population_preparation_and_design: Randomized crossover device/light exposure in competitive cyclists.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: VO2 kinetics during exercise assessed; physical device intervention, not a molecule.
records.uncertainty: No compound efficacy credit.

records.title: Ganglioside therapy for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a double-blind controlled trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 40 people with ALS in six-month double-blind controlled study of daily intramuscular bovine-brain gangliosides 40 mg or placebo.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Ten objective muscle-strength tests showed no significant difference in weakness progression.
records.uncertainty: Historical controlled functional null; retain exact formulation and study period.

records.title: Subcutaneous immunoglobulin for chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyradiculoneuropathy.
records.role: Subcutaneous immunoglobulin in CIDP systematic review
records.population_preparation_and_design: Cochrane-style review of SCIg induction/maintenance studies in CIDP.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Reviews benefits/harms; no new administered cohort.
records.uncertainty: Secondary evidence only.

records.title: Unmasking Idiopathic Inflammatory Myopathy: A Case of Proximal Weakness in a Young Male With Co-Occurring Vitamin D Deficiency.
records.role: Vitamin D use in a case of inflammatory myopathy
records.population_preparation_and_design: Single-patient case report: 50,000 IU weekly vitamin D given before diagnosis; proximal weakness progressed.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Clinical course reports progression despite supplementation, later biopsy-supported inflammatory myopathy.
records.uncertainty: Uncontrolled case and coexisting deficiency; cannot infer vitamin-D inefficacy in general or muscle rescue.

records.title: High-dose intravenous immunoglobulin in inflammatory myopathies: experience based on controlled clinical trials.
records.role: Review of IVIG trials in inflammatory myopathy
records.population_preparation_and_design: Secondary review/commentary summarizes controlled IVIG trials in dermatomyositis and IBM.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Discusses strength/histology outcomes from prior trials; no new intervention group.
records.uncertainty: Do not count the cited trials again as independent results.

records.title: Aroxybutynin and atomoxetine (AD109) for the treatment of obstructive sleep apnea: Rationale, design and baseline characteristics of the phase 3 clinical trials.
records.role: AD109 phase 3 obstructive sleep apnea trial rationale/protocol
records.population_preparation_and_design: Design/baseline report for placebo-controlled phase 3 trials of oral aroxybutynin plus atomoxetine.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Upper-airway muscle-tone rationale and planned apnea outcomes; no trial efficacy results.
records.uncertainty: Investigational mixture and protocol-only source; not skeletal-muscle treatment evidence.

records.title: The Effects of Quercetin Supplementation on Eccentric Exercise-Induced Muscle Damage.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 12 young men completed randomized double-blind crossover of quercetin 1000 mg/day or placebo for 14 days around eccentric exercise.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Torque/strength loss and muscle-fiber conduction velocity decay were less under quercetin after damaging exercise.
records.uncertainty: Very small healthy-volunteer crossover; acute recovery outcome and high supplement dose, no chronic disease benefit.

records.title: Clinical investigation in Duchenne muscular dystrophy: IV. Double-blind controlled trial of leucine.
records.role: Leucine supplementation in Duchenne muscular dystrophy
records.population_preparation_and_design: 96 boys/men with DMD randomized double-blind to oral leucine 0.2 g/kg/day or placebo over six months, with natural-history phase.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Transient strength/contracture differences reflected unexpected placebo-group decline; authors concluded no therapeutic leucine effect.
records.uncertainty: Historical trial; retain the natural-history slope context that explains misleading transient contrasts.

records.title: Opposing Effects of Dietary Nitrate on Muscle Contractile Function in Fast and Slow Human Muscles.
records.role: Acute beetroot nitrate and human muscle contractility
records.population_preparation_and_design: 14 healthy young men in double-blind placebo-controlled crossover of nitrate-rich versus nitrate-depleted beetroot juice.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Nitrate did not change peak twitch torque/rates in fast or slow muscles; shifted torque-frequency curves in opposite directions by muscle group.
records.uncertainty: Acute healthy-volunteer physiology, opposing muscle-type effects, no general strength or clinical benefit.

records.title: The Effects of a Korean Ginseng, GINST15, on Perceptual Effort, Psychomotor Performance, and Physical Performance in Men and Women.
records.role: GINST15 Korean ginseng after resistance exercise
records.population_preparation_and_design: 19 adults completed 3-cycle high-dose 960 mg/day, low-dose 160 mg/day and placebo testing; each period 14 days.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: High dose reduced perceived exertion; both doses reduced soreness; peak-power benefit appeared only in post hoc responder subgroup.
records.uncertainty: Small mixed-sex study; responder split and multiple measures limit confirmatory value.

records.title: Influence of Beetroot Juice Ingestion on Neuromuscular Performance on Semi-Professional Female Rugby Players: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study.
records.role: Acute beetroot juice in female rugby players
records.population_preparation_and_design: 14 semi-professional women assigned beetroot juice or nitrate-depleted placebo in two test sessions.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: CMJ improved 7.7% with beetroot; handgrip and other battery outcomes did not uniformly improve.
records.uncertainty: Small sport-specific acute study; no MVA or durable muscle outcome.

records.title: Minimum Effective Doses of Succinylcholine and Rocuronium During Electroconvulsive Therapy: A Prospective, Randomized, Crossover Trial.
records.role: Succinylcholine versus rocuronium for ECT muscle blockade
records.population_preparation_and_design: 45 patients across 227 ECT sessions in randomized crossover dose-titration comparison.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Evoked contraction control and neuromuscular recovery measured to optimize procedural paralysis.
records.uncertainty: Procedural muscle-relaxant choice, not muscle-strength therapy or repurposing rationale.

records.title: Motor Unit Fatigability following Chronic Carnosine Supplementation in Aged Rats.
records.role: Carnosine supplementation and aged rat motor-unit fatigability
records.population_preparation_and_design: 40 15-month-old male rats assigned to control or 0.1% carnosine diet for 10 or 34 weeks.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Fast/slow motor-unit force and fatigue measured; supplementation maintained force in fast-fatigable units during fatigue decline.
records.uncertainty: Preclinical aging model and tissue-specific assay; no human or BUB1B/MVA evidence.

records.title: Caffeine intake reverses the impairment of sleep restriction on high-intensity exercise performance.
records.role: Caffeine after sleep restriction and high-intensity exercise
records.population_preparation_and_design: Nine active men completed habitual-sleep/placebo, restricted-sleep/placebo and restricted-sleep/caffeine conditions.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: High-intensity exercise to task failure plus quadriceps fatigue measures assessed.
records.uncertainty: Small sleep/exercise interaction study; acute performance context only.

records.title: Riluzole for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS)/motor neuron disease (MND).
records.population_preparation_and_design: Systematic review of randomized controlled riluzole studies in ALS.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Reviews survival and disease progression; no new treatment cohort.
records.uncertainty: Secondary source, not an independent trial.

records.title: Effects of 8 weeks of Xpand® 2X pre workout supplementation on skeletal muscle hypertrophy, lean body mass, and strength in resistance trained males.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 20 resistance-trained men randomized double-blind to proprietary multi-ingredient pre-workout or placebo during eight weeks of training.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Muscle hypertrophy, lean mass and lower-body strength measured.
records.uncertainty: Mixture contains several actives; cannot assign any effect to one ingredient.

records.title: Initial Psychometric Evaluation of the Barth Syndrome Symptom Assessment (BTHS-SA) for Adolescents and Adults in a Phase 2 Clinical Study.
records.role: Elamipretide symptom-assessment psychometrics in Barth syndrome
records.population_preparation_and_design: Patient-reported instrument evaluated using participants from a prior phase 2 randomized elamipretide crossover study.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Reliability/validity of symptom scores assessed; no new treatment efficacy contrast.
records.uncertainty: Measurement validation is not an independent treatment result.

records.title: The effects of doxapram on time to tracheal extubation and early recovery in young morbidly obese patients scheduled for bariatric surgery: A randomised controlled trial.
records.role: Doxapram and early recovery after bariatric anesthesia
records.population_preparation_and_design: 100 morbidly obese surgical patients randomized to doxapram or control following general anesthesia.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Time to extubation and early recovery measures compared.
records.uncertainty: Perioperative respiratory recovery indication; not evidence of improved skeletal-muscle function.

records.title: Reduced neuromuscular activity with carbohydrate ingestion during constant load cycling.
records.role: Carbohydrate drink during cycling to fatigue
records.population_preparation_and_design: Eight trained cyclists in crossover carbohydrate-electrolyte drink versus placebo during intense constant-load cycling.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Exercise time was numerically longer with carbohydrate but not statistically different; EMG activity also measured.
records.uncertainty: Very small acute exercise study; retain performance null despite mechanistic measures.

records.title: Long-Term Beetroot Extract Supplementation Improves Morphological Muscle Quality and Rate of Force Development in Postmenopausal Women: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
records.role: Long-term nitrate-rich beetroot extract in postmenopausal women
records.population_preparation_and_design: 20 postmenopausal women randomized double-blind to nitrate-rich or nitrate-depleted beetroot extract 20 g/day for 12 weeks.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Morphological muscle quality and RFD improved; functional muscle-quality contrast and treatment-by-time MVIC interaction were not significant.
records.uncertainty: Small study; distinguish contractile RFD from maximum strength and morphology; no disease transfer.

records.title: Safety and efficacy of risdiplam in patients with type 1 spinal muscular atrophy (FIREFISH part 2): secondary analyses from an open-label trial.
records.role: Two-year risdiplam in infant SMA type 1 open-label study
records.population_preparation_and_design: Infants in FIREFISH part 2 received open-label risdiplam; month-24 outcomes compared with historical controls.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Motor milestone/function improvement or stabilization reported longitudinally.
records.uncertainty: No concurrent control after open-label treatment; external natural-history comparison and parent study context remain.

records.title: Effects of Nutritional Support Combined with Neuromuscular Electrical Stimulation on Muscle Strength and Thickness: A Randomized Controlled Trial in Healthy Young Adult Males.
records.role: Whey protein plus NMES in healthy young men
records.population_preparation_and_design: 38 hands from healthy young men randomized within-person across placebo, nutrition, NMES and combined nutrition+NMES for six weeks.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Combined whey+NMES improved strength versus placebo/NMES; no significant muscle-thickness gain.
records.uncertainty: Small hand-level study with device interaction; nutrition-alone effect not shown, no patient muscle disease.

records.title: Effects of Caffeine-Taurine Co-Ingestion on Endurance Cycling Performance in High Temperature and Humidity Environments.
records.role: Caffeine and taurine in hot/humid cycling
records.population_preparation_and_design: 12 university students in single-blind randomized crossover of placebo, taurine, caffeine or combination.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: All active conditions improved time-to-exhaustion versus placebo; combination showed no additive effect.
records.uncertainty: Small acute sports study, environmental heat and subjective performance context; no chronic disease benefit.

records.title: Repeated 5-day cycles of low dose aldesleukin in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (IMODALS): A phase 2a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Three-arm randomized double-blind trial of two aldesleukin doses or placebo in ALS.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Primary pharmacodynamic T-regulatory-cell percentage and blood biomarkers; no direct muscle/function endpoint in abstract.
records.uncertainty: Mechanism/safety study only at this source depth; biomarkers do not establish motor benefit.

records.title: Corticosteroids for Guillain-Barré syndrome.
records.role: Corticosteroids in Guillain-Barre syndrome Cochrane review
records.population_preparation_and_design: Systematic review of randomized/quasi-randomized corticosteroid or ACTH trials.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Disability and walking recovery outcomes synthesized; no new cohort.
records.uncertainty: Secondary review, acute neuropathy context.

records.title: Use of trunk muscle training and neuromuscular electrical stimulation to reduce pain and disability in an older adult with chronic low back pain: A case report.
records.role: NMES and trunk training case report in chronic back pain
records.population_preparation_and_design: Single 83-year-old woman received supervised trunk training plus NMES and home exercise.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: SPPB, TUG and disability measured pre/post; physical-device/intervention case report, not a compound.
records.uncertainty: Uncontrolled single case and multimodal therapy; no substance evidence.

records.title: Therapeutic doses of neostigmine, depolarising neuromuscular blockade and muscle weakness in awake volunteers: a double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomised volunteer study.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 21 healthy volunteers randomized double-blind to neostigmine/glycopyrrolate or saline; only nine active participants accepted the second dose.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Grip strength and spirometry declined dose-dependently after neostigmine.
records.uncertainty: Small perioperative physiology/safety study; adverse pharmacology, not a candidate to improve muscle function.

records.title: Postactivation Potentiation of the Plantar Flexors Does Not Directly Translate to Jump Performance in Female Elite Young Soccer Players.
records.role: Postactivation potentiation and jump performance in young soccer players
records.population_preparation_and_design: 12 adolescent female elite players completed randomized exercise-only balance/strength conditions.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Twitch potentiation and jump performance did not map directly; exercise/device-style conditioning rather than a compound.
records.uncertainty: Training mechanism context only, no administered molecule.

records.title: Variable resistance training promotes greater fatigue resistance but not hypertrophy versus constant resistance training.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Men completed 20-week resistance-training comparison with nontraining controls; no compound intervention.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Leg press strength, failure repetitions, volume and muscle mass assessed.
records.uncertainty: Exercise-method study, not a drug or nutrient treatment.

records.title: Acute acetaminophen ingestion improves performance and muscle activation during maximal intermittent knee extensor exercise.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 13 active men completed placebo/acetaminophen crossover sessions during repeated maximal contractions.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Torque impulse and neuromuscular fatigue measured; acute analgesic/ergogenic context.
records.uncertainty: Small healthy-volunteer laboratory study; chronic safety and clinical muscle function not addressed.

records.title: Acute Caffeine Ingestion, Calendar-Based Menstrual-Cycle Window, Time of Day, and Match-Induced Fatigue Independently and Interactively Influence Psychophysiological, Cognitive, and Physical Performance in Elite Female Volleyball Players: A Randomized Double-Blind Placebo-Controlled Crossover Design Study.
records.role: Caffeine in female elite volleyball performance
records.population_preparation_and_design: 13 elite women in randomized double-blind crossover across caffeine/placebo, cycle windows, time of day and match fatigue.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Cognitive/physical sport performance assessed.
records.uncertainty: Many factors and 12 sessions; calendar-based cycle window does not prove hormonal phase; athletic context.

records.title: Treatment for ulnar neuropathy at the elbow.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Updated systematic review of conservative and surgical treatments.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Symptoms, nerve function and clinical outcomes synthesized; no new cohort.
records.uncertainty: Review, not an independent compound result.

records.title: The effects of endurance exercise and vitamin E on oxidative stress in the elderly.
records.role: Vitamin E with endurance exercise in older adults
records.population_preparation_and_design: 59 older adults assigned to exercise or sedentary conditions crossed with vitamin E or placebo for 16 weeks.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: VO2max/aerobic fitness and oxidative biomarkers measured.
records.uncertainty: Exercise and supplement effects must be separated; small factorial group sizes and aging population.

records.title: Effects of surface treatments on the adhesion strengths between polyether ether ketone and both composite resins and poly(methyl methacrylate).
records.role: Surface bonding treatments for dental materials
records.population_preparation_and_design: Laboratory study of PEEK, composite and PMMA specimens with chemical surface treatments.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Material shear bond strength measured, not biological muscle function.
records.uncertainty: Material-engineering outcome, off-scope.

records.title: Effect of Omega-3 and Vitamins E + C Supplements on the Concentration of Serum B-Vitamins and Plasma Redox Aminothiol Antioxidant Status in Elderly Men after Strength Training for Three Months.
records.role: Omega-3 or vitamins E+C during older-men strength training
records.population_preparation_and_design: 50 older men randomized to placebo, omega-3 or vitamins E+C while all groups completed three months of strength training.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Serum B-vitamins and redox aminothiol biomarkers measured; no direct strength/function effect in abstract.
records.uncertainty: Biomarker-focused secondary analysis; shared training and multi-ingredient vitamins limit function attribution.

records.title: Lessons learned from a combined, personalized lifestyle intervention in hospitalized patients at risk for sarcopenia: a feasibility study.
records.role: Personalized protein and exercise intervention feasibility
records.population_preparation_and_design: 14 of 115 eligible hospitalized patients at risk of sarcopenia entered a randomized nutrition-plus-exercise feasibility intervention; 7/14 dropped out.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Feasibility and exercise/functional outcomes observed; not powered for efficacy.
records.uncertainty: Very low recruitment and 50% attrition, multicomponent intervention and small sample.

records.title: Protein-energy oral supplementation in malnourished nursing-home residents. A controlled trial.
records.role: Protein-energy supplementation in malnourished nursing-home residents
records.population_preparation_and_design: 88 older residents in controlled nutritional intervention; supplementation assigned among those at risk of malnutrition.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Grip strength, weight and nutritional status assessed over 60 days.
records.uncertainty: Malnutrition-selected groups and energy-dense mixture; exact randomized denominators/results require appraisal.

records.title: Shatavari Supplementation in Postmenopausal Women Improves Handgrip Strength and Increases Vastus Lateralis Myosin Regulatory Light Chain Phosphorylation But Does Not Alter Markers of Bone Turnover: A Randomised Controlled Trial
records.population_preparation_and_design: Preprint randomized double-blind trial; 20 postmenopausal women received 1000 mg/day Shatavari or placebo for six weeks.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Grip strength reportedly improved; knee-extensor strength did not.
records.uncertainty: Tiny preprint (10/group), no independent publication/replication; single primary/secondary signal and extract-specific.

records.title: Effects of dried tofu supplementation during interval walking training on the methylation of the NFKB2 gene in the whole blood of older women.
records.role: Dried tofu during interval walking in older women
records.population_preparation_and_design: 32 older women randomized to tofu or low-protein placebo intake during interval walking for five months.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Thigh muscle mass/strength and inflammatory methylation outcomes assessed.
records.uncertainty: Exercise shared; macronutrient/protein contrast is the active difference; cannot attribute to soy isoflavones alone.

records.title: Integrating exercise and nutrition to combat frailty: a systematic review of multidomain interventions in aging populations.
records.role: Exercise and nutrition interventions for frailty systematic review
records.population_preparation_and_design: Systematic review of RCTs and multidomain interventions in aging populations.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Synthesizes frailty, strength and physical performance; no new cohort.
records.uncertainty: Review-level evidence; mixtures and exercise effects remain distinct.

records.title: Effects of a Multi-Ingredient MCT-Leucine-Creatine-Based Supplement (TLN-01) on Muscle Mass, Strength, and Plasma Amino Acid Profiles in Older Adults with Sarcopenia: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 73 older adults meeting AWGS sarcopenia criteria randomized to TLN-01 or isocaloric placebo for eight weeks without structured exercise.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Primary appendicular mass increased modestly; handgrip strength did not differ between groups.
records.uncertainty: Proprietary mixture (whey/BCAA/MCT/creatine/resveratrol/D3); mass gain below cited MCID, no component attribution or function benefit.

records.title: The effects of hypogonadism on quality of life in survivors of germ cell tumors treated with surgery alone versus surgery plus platinum-based chemotherapy.
records.role: Testosterone and quality of life in germ-cell tumor survivors
records.population_preparation_and_design: Prospective observational cohort of 199 survivors treated with surgery +/- platinum; testosterone given when clinically indicated.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Quality-of-life scales tracked at baseline, three and six months.
records.uncertainty: Nonrandomized treatment by indication, no fixed exposure comparator and not a muscle-function outcome.

records.title: Different protein and derivatives supplementation strategies combined with resistance training in pre-frail and frail elderly: Rationale and protocol for the "Pro-Elderly" Study.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Protocol for four sub-studies combining supplementation and resistance training in pre-frail/frail older adults.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Planned body/health outcomes; no results.
records.uncertainty: Protocol only; no efficacy credit.

records.title: A Patented Dietary Supplement (Hydroxy-Methyl-Butyrate, Carnosine, Magnesium, Butyrate, Lactoferrin) Is a Promising Therapeutic Target for Age-Related Sarcopenia through the Regulation of Gut Permeability: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 59 older adults randomized to multi-ingredient supplement or placebo; about 12-week sarcopenia intervention.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Paper reports improvements in grip, chair, SPPB and walking speed versus placebo, plus mass and biomarkers.
records.uncertainty: High-risk reporting inconsistency: SMI CI crosses zero while p=.001; product proprietary, n mismatch (59 enrolled vs 58 arm counts), and component effects unknown. Independent full-source review required.

records.title: Effects of vitamin D and calcium supplementation on falls: a randomized controlled trial.
records.role: Vitamin D plus calcium and falls/musculoskeletal function
records.population_preparation_and_design: 122 very old women in long-stay geriatric care randomized double-blind to calcium+800 IU cholecalciferol or calcium alone for 12 weeks.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Falls reduced 49%; secondary combined strength/grip/TUG function improved.
records.uncertainty: Old institutionalized cohort and combined fall/function composite; baseline deficiency status and transportability need source review.

records.title: Effects of 30 days of creatine ingestion in older men.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 20 men aged 60–82 randomized double-blind to creatine loading/maintenance or placebo for 30 days.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Elbow strength and knee-extensor fatigue measured; abstract reports group-by-time fatigue interaction with details needed.
records.uncertainty: Small short trial, exact muscle/task estimates not in abstract.

records.title: Impact of Pomegranate Extract Supplementation on Physical and Cognitive Function in Community-Dwelling Older Adults Aged 55-70 Years: A Randomised Double-Blind Clinical Trial.
records.role: Pomegranate extract and physical function in older adults
records.population_preparation_and_design: 86 adults aged 55–70 randomized double-blind to 740 mg/day extract or maltodextrin for 12 weeks.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Physical-function battery (balance, gait, chair rise, grip) did not appear affected; cognitive test signal reported.
records.uncertainty: Physical-function null in active community cohort; cognitive findings do not establish muscle benefit.

records.title: Chronic nicotinamide mononucleotide supplementation elevates blood nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide levels and alters muscle motility in healthy old men
records.role: NMN preprint version of human muscle-function trial
records.population_preparation_and_design: Research Square 2021 preprint of a placebo-controlled randomized double-blind parallel trial of NMN 250 mg/day in healthy older men for six or 12 weeks.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: The preprint reports increased blood NAD and improvements in chair-stand, walking speed and grip; the peer-reviewed 2022 version (PMID 35927255) describes gait and left-grip findings as nominal and requiring larger validation.
records.uncertainty: Likely same cohort and trial as the 2022 Igarashi publication; link as a version, not an independent study or additional efficacy count. No BUBR1/MVA endpoint.

records.title: Comprehensive geriatric intervention in community-dwelling older adults: a cluster-randomized controlled trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 526 community-dwelling older adults; 12-week class or home lifestyle package with exercise, oral function and nutrition guidance.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Both arms improved strength, speed and thigh size; classes improved some outcomes more. No isolated compound contrast.
records.uncertainty: No named medicine or supplement.

records.title: The efficacy of Sarcomeal® oral supplementation plus vitamin D3 on muscle parameters, metabolic factors, and quality of life in diabetic sarcopenia: a randomized controlled clinical trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 60 adults with diabetic sarcopenia randomized to daily mixture plus D3 or shared lifestyle advice for 12 weeks.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Lean mass favored the mixture; grip/SMI between-group contrasts were null despite within-arm changes.
records.uncertainty: Combination attribution and open-label design.

records.title: Zoledronic acid and bone health in older adults with cognitive impairment.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Post hoc subgroup of 43 cognitively impaired women from a placebo-controlled trial.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: BMD and bone markers improved; no function/fracture endpoint reported.
records.uncertainty: Secondary subgroup; bone does not establish muscle benefit.

records.title: Lack of dehydroepiandrosterone effect on a combined endurance and resistance exercise program in postmenopausal women.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 31 postmenopausal women randomized to 50 mg/day DHEA or placebo during 12-week training.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Training improved function; DHEA added no benefit.
records.uncertainty: Exercise effects are shared.

records.title: Pre-Operative nutrition In Neck of femur Trial (POINT)--carbohydrate loading in patients with fragility hip fracture: study protocol for a randomised controlled trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Planned blinded perioperative carbohydrate drinks in older hip-fracture patients.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Protocol only; no outcomes.
records.uncertainty: Link eventual report.

records.title: Effects of High-Dose Vitamin D Supplementation on Phase Angle and Physical Function in Patients with Prostate Cancer on ADT.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 59 older men randomized to high/low-dose vitamin D for 24 weeks; function tests were listed.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Abstract reports phase-angle results only, not function contrasts.
records.uncertainty: Unreported outcomes are not measured nulls.

records.title: Beneficial effects of exercise, testosterone, vitamin D, calcium and protein in older men-A randomized clinical trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 148 older men in four 20-week randomized arms: testosterone, exercise/supplements, both, or no intervention.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Full bundle improved chair stands; component effects cannot be isolated.
records.uncertainty: Multicomponent and selected low-testosterone population.

records.title: ORALLY ADMINISTERED UROLITHIN A IS SAFE AND MODULATES MUSCLE AND MITOCHONDRIAL BIOMARKERS IN ELDERLY
records.population_preparation_and_design: 60 healthy older adults in randomized dose-escalation study with four-week biopsy follow-up.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Safety and muscle biomarkers reported; no functional outcome.
records.uncertainty: Biomarker evidence only.

records.title: Ingestion of a Multi-Ingredient Supplement Does Not Alter Exercise-Induced Satellite Cell Responses in Older Men.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 27 older men received whey/creatine/D/calcium/omega-3 mix or maltodextrin, then exercise and biopsies.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Mixture did not alter satellite-cell response; no functional treatment outcome.
records.uncertainty: Mixture-level mechanistic endpoint.

records.title: Multifaceted nutritional intervention among nursing-home residents has a positive influence on nutrition and function.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Nursing-home residents randomized to 11-week multi-component program or control.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Weight/protein/balance improved; follow-up deaths were 15 versus 8.
records.uncertainty: Component attribution and mortality imbalance need review.

records.title: The effect of protein and essential amino acid supplementation on muscle strength and performance in patients with chronic heart failure: a systematic review.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Review of five RCTs and one cohort.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: No clear strength effect; possible walking/mass/QoL signals with high bias.
records.uncertainty: Review, not new trial.

records.title: 12 Weeks of Physical Exercise Attenuates Oxidative Stress, Improves Functional Tests Performance, and Reduces Fall Risk in Elderly Women Independently on Serum 25(OH)D Concentration.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 37 older women in supplemented/non-supplemented and exercise/control groups; D preparation/dose/assignment unclear.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Exercise improved walking/TUG; no interpretable supplement contrast.
records.uncertainty: Exposure versus measured status unresolved.

records.title: Effects of resistance training combined with creatine supplementation on muscle strength, physical function, and muscle mass in older adults: a systematic review and three-level meta-analysis.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Three-level meta-analysis of 11 older-adult RCTs.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Small pooled strength benefit; mass/function pools nonsignificant with low certainty.
records.uncertainty: Review only; no new study.

records.title: Clinical and cost-effectiveness of oral sodium bicarbonate therapy for older patients with chronic kidney disease and low-grade acidosis (BiCARB): a pragmatic randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 300 older adults randomized to bicarbonate/placebo for up to two years.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: SPPB null; more adverse events and lower QoL/cost-effectiveness.
records.uncertainty: Specific acidosis population.

records.title: Effect of oral magnesium supplementation on physical performance in healthy elderly women involved in a weekly exercise program: a randomized controlled trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 139 women randomized to 300 mg/day or no treatment during 12 weeks of mild fitness.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: SPPB, chair time and walking favored magnesium; strength/grip secondary outcomes null.
records.uncertainty: No placebo, attrition and dietary-intake subgroup.

records.title: Should handgrip strength be considered when choosing the administration mode of oral nutritional supplements in geriatric patients? A secondary analysis of the MEDPass Trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Secondary analysis of 188 hospitalized MEDPass participants.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Energy/protein coverage differed by subgroup/mode; no muscle-function treatment endpoint.
records.uncertainty: Nutrient-coverage process outcome.

records.title: Systematic druggable genome-wide Mendelian randomization identifies therapeutic targets for sarcopenia.
records.population_preparation_and_design: In-silico eQTL/pQTL/GWAS and target analysis; no compound administered.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Zinc/collagenase suggestions are computational.
records.uncertainty: Not drug efficacy evidence.

records.title: The Influence of Specific Bioactive Collagen Peptides on Body Composition and Muscle Strength in Middle-Aged, Untrained Men: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 97 middle-aged men randomized to peptides, placebo or whey during 12-week training.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: All groups gained strength; no peptide strength advantage; lean mass favored peptides versus placebo.
records.uncertainty: Do not translate mass to force.

records.title: A randomized controlled trial of low-dose recombinant human growth hormone in the treatment of malnourished elderly medical patients.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 19 malnourished older inpatients randomized to GH or saline for four weeks with diet support.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Lean mass and walking improved short term; benefit faded after stopping.
records.uncertainty: Tiny selected adult cohort.

records.title: Nutritional supplementation boosts aerobic exercise effects on functional brain systems.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Older adults randomized to walking, dance, walking plus mixed supplement or active control.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Some brain connectivity changed; cognition did not improve; no muscle outcome.
records.uncertainty: Cannot assign mixture result to beta-alanine.

records.title: Enhancing Muscle Strength and Reducing Inflammation: The Combined Effects of Hydrolyzed House Cricket Protein Supplementation and Concurrent Training in Older Women.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 39 older women randomized among protein, training, both or placebo for 12 weeks.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Some active groups improved strength/walk, including training alone; between-arm details incomplete.
records.uncertainty: Small factorial sample; synergy unproven.

records.title: Effect of Oral Beta-Hydroxy-Beta-Methylbutyrate (HMB) Supplementation on Physical Performance in Healthy Old Women Over 65 Years: An Open Label Randomized Controlled Trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 80 women in open-label randomized 8-week 1.5 g/day study; 65 completed.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: SPPB/grip/DXA null; selected torque, walk and endurance outcomes favored HMB.
records.uncertainty: Primary null, open label, multiple secondary outcomes.

records.title: Subcutaneous Neurotrophin-3 infusion induces corticospinal neuroplasticity and improvements in dexterity and walking in elderly rats after large cortical stroke
records.population_preparation_and_design: Elderly rats randomized to one-month subcutaneous NT-3 after cortical stroke.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Rat dexterity, walking and sensory function improved.
records.uncertainty: Stroke/protein model; not MVA or muscle rescue.

records.title: Effects of Combined Whole-Body Electromyostimulation and Protein Supplementation on Local and Overall Muscle/Fat Distribution in Older Men with Sarcopenic Obesity: The Randomized Controlled Franconia Sarcopenic Obesity (FranSO) Study.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Older men with sarcopenic obesity randomized to WB-EMS plus protein versus no intervention.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Combined arm improved mass, gait and leg performance.
records.uncertainty: No separate EMS or protein arm.

records.title: Native Whey Induces Similar Adaptation to Strength Training as Milk, despite Higher Levels of Leucine, in Elderly Individuals.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 30 healthy older adults randomized during strength training.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Both arms gained strength/mass; no supplement difference.
records.uncertainty: No nonprotein control.

records.title: A study protocol for a randomised controlled trial assessing the effects of daily supplementation with defatted almond protein powder on fitness training adaptations and metabolic health in overweight and obese post-menopausal women.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Planned placebo-controlled study during resistance/HIIT in postmenopausal women.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Protocol only.
records.uncertainty: No results.

records.title: The Effect of Resistance Training and Different Sources of Postexercise Protein Supplementation on Muscle Mass and Physical Capacity in Sarcopenic Elderly Men.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 26 sarcopenic older men randomized across protein sources/control, all exercising.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: All arms improved mass/strength; no between-arm difference.
records.uncertainty: Small trial; common training may explain gains.

records.title: Protein supplementation before and after resistance training in older men.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 29 older men randomized to protein before/after training or placebo.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Training improved outcomes; little difference between supplement groups.
records.uncertainty: No timing advantage.

records.title: Supplemental vitamin D and physical performance in COPD: a pilot randomized trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 36 men randomized to D or placebo for six weeks.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: 25(OH)D rose but SPPB/QoL did not improve.
records.uncertainty: Small short disease-specific study.

records.title: PROMETHEUS clinical trial protocol: tailoring healthy ageing with lifestyle and nutraceuticals.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Adaptive multimodal 8-week package including whey, creatine, fucoidan and personalized Urolithin A/NMN/multivitamin.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Protocol only; compounds inseparable and results not reported.
records.uncertainty: No efficacy credit.

records.title: Effect of calcium phosphate bone cement augmentation on volar plate fixation of unstable distal radial fractures in the elderly.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 48 older adults randomized to plate fixation with/without local cement.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Grip, wrist motion, pain and function did not differ.
records.uncertainty: Local surgical material, not systemic supplementation.

records.title: Increased intramuscular adipose tissue of the quadriceps is more strongly related to declines in ADL than is loss of muscle mass in older inpatients.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Cross-sectional study of 371 older inpatients.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Quadriceps echo intensity associated with ADL; no treatment.
records.uncertainty: Association only.

records.title: Effects of oral HPΒCD-angiotensin-(1-7) supplementation on recreational mountain bike athletes: a crossover study.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 21 male recreational athletes in randomized crossover of peptide formulation versus vehicle.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: No cycling/sprint or EMG benefit; selected biomarkers changed.
records.uncertainty: Small acute study; biomarker shift did not improve performance.

records.title: Dietary Nitrate Increases VO<sub>2</sub>peak and Performance but Does Not Alter Ventilation or Efficiency in Patients With Heart Failure With Reduced Ejection Fraction.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Eight patients in randomized crossover of beetroot nitrate vs depleted juice.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: VO2peak +8%, fatigue time +7%; efficiency/ventilation unchanged.
records.uncertainty: Very small acute study.

records.title: A systematic review examining the effect of vitamin D supplementation on functional outcomes post-stroke.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Review of ten adult intervention studies, eight randomized.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Motor/mobility signals; uncertain clinical importance and inconsistent ADL benefit.
records.uncertainty: Review; deduplicate primary studies.

records.title: Caffeine improves biochemical and specific performance after judo training: a double-blind crossover study in a real judo training situation.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Eight athletes in crossover of 5 mg/kg caffeine vs placebo.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Fatigue-index performance maintained with caffeine.
records.uncertainty: Tiny young-athlete sample, acute dose.

records.title: Quality of life during and between hemodialysis treatments: role of L-carnitine supplementation.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 101 patients received oral L-carnitine or placebo for three/six months.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Self-reported function/general health improved early, not sustained at six months.
records.uncertainty: Dialysis-specific and subjective.

records.title: Antiosteoporotic activity of echinacoside in ovariectomized rats.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Ovariectomized rats received oral echinacoside or controls for 12 weeks.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Bone density and tibial biomechanical strength improved.
records.uncertainty: Animal bone, not muscle outcome.

records.title: Effects of acute supplementation of L-arginine and nitrate on endurance and sprint performance in elite athletes.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Nine elite men in crossover of arginine+nitrate, nitrate or placebo.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Nitrate raised nitrite; no running-economy/5-km benefit or extra arginine effect.
records.uncertainty: Small acute athlete study.

records.title: Function of vitamin E in physical exercise: a review.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Narrative review mixing animal and preliminary human evidence.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: No single new controlled contrast.
records.uncertainty: Secondary source.

records.title: Diclofenac plus B vitamins versus diclofenac monotherapy in lumbago: the DOLOR study.
records.role: Diclofenac plus B vitamins for lumbago
records.population_preparation_and_design: 372 patients randomized to combination or diclofenac alone for up to seven days.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Short-term pain-related success and mobility favored combination.
records.uncertainty: Analgesia context; cannot isolate vitamins; early stopping after success.

records.title: Evaluation of the effect of vitamin D supplementation on spermatogram, seminal and serum levels of oxidative stress indices in asthenospermia infertile men: a study protocol for a triple-blind, randomized controlled trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Planned blinded trial in 86 vitamin-D-insufficient infertile men.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Protocol only; reproductive outcomes planned.
records.uncertainty: No results.

records.title: Probiotic Supplementation Can Alter Inflammation Parameters and Self-Reported Sleep After a Marathon: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 27 male runners randomized to probiotic mixture or maltodextrin for 30 days.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Self-reported sleep favored probiotic; cytokines/LPS had no between-group differences; no muscle benefit.
records.uncertainty: Sleep is not muscle function; fixed mixed strains.

records.title: Randomized Controlled Trial of Lifestyle Walking for African American Women: Blood Pressure Outcomes.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 288 sedentary women randomized to support-call formats.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Blood pressure fell; no compound administered.
records.uncertainty: Lifestyle only.

records.title: Acute Effect of Caffeine-Based Multi-Ingredient Supplement on Reactive Agility and Jump Height in Recreational Handball Players.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 24 handball players in crossover of placebo, caffeine+guarana or mixture.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Agility favored mixture versus placebo; jump null and no edge versus caffeine+guarana.
records.uncertainty: Acute mixture and small sample.

records.title: Carbohydrate supplementation and immune responses after acute exhaustive resistance exercise.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 19 young athletes received CHO/placebo around lifting; immune markers measured.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Lymphocyte response changed; no strength/performance endpoint.
records.uncertainty: Biomarker only.

records.title: Benefits and Harms of Prescription Drugs and Supplements for Treatment of Clinical Alzheimer-Type Dementia.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Systematic review of dementia trials.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Mostly small/uncertain effects; supplement evidence insufficient.
records.uncertainty: Review, no new treatment study.

records.title: Antioxidant supplementation does not alter endurance training adaptation.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 21 moderately trained men randomized to combined vitamins or placebo for 12 weeks.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Both groups adapted; no between-group performance/physiology advantage.
records.uncertainty: Combined preparation and nondeficient young men.

records.title: Effect of Spirulina maxima Supplementation and a Systematic Physical Exercise Program on Body Composition and Cardiorespiratory Fitness of Overweight or Obese Subjects: A Double Blind Randomized, Crossover Controlled Trial
records.population_preparation_and_design: 52 overweight/obese men in crossover exercise/no-exercise conditions with 4.5 g/day Spirulina or none.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Abstract reports time-to-fatigue/lactate-onset signals; factorial estimates need checking.
records.uncertainty: Selected sample and abstract-only uncertainty.

records.title: Should Exogenous Ketone Body Supplementation Be Considered in Patients Hospitalized for Acute Heart Failure? Rationale and Design of the KETO-AHF Trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Planned 30-day randomized study in acute heart failure.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Protocol only; walking outcome planned.
records.uncertainty: No efficacy result.

records.title: Impact of prolonged exercise in the heat and carbohydrate supplementation on performance of a virtual environment task.
records.role: Carbohydrate and virtual task during exercise
records.population_preparation_and_design: 10 men tested exercise/heat conditions with CHO or placebo.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Fewer virtual-task failures with CHO; cognitive task, not muscle output.
records.uncertainty: Tiny acute study.

records.title: Consumption of an oral carbohydrate-protein gel improves cycling endurance and prevents postexercise muscle damage.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 13 cyclists in crossover of CHO-protein versus CHO gel.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Time-to-exhaustion 13% longer; CK not significantly different.
records.uncertainty: Small acute study.

records.title: Impact of exercise on bone health and contraindication of oral contraceptive use in young women.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Young women stratified by contraceptive use; exercise randomized, contraceptive not assigned.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Exercise/bone outcomes only; no drug contrast.
records.uncertainty: Exposure subgroup only.

records.title: [Effect of phlebodium decumanum and coenzyme Q10 on sports performance in professional volleyball players].
records.population_preparation_and_design: 30 trained men randomized to Phlebodium, mixture or placebo during training.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Abstract provides blood markers, not an actual performance task.
records.uncertainty: Mixture and biomarker-only result.

records.title: Cognitive and Mood Effects of a Soluble Mango Leaf Extract (Zynamite<sup>®</sup> S): A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Crossover Replication Trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 88 healthy young adults in placebo-controlled crossover after one 100-mg dose.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Cognitive tests/mood favored extract; no muscle or motor endpoint.
records.uncertainty: Cognitive/proprietary preparation.

records.title: Effects of Four-Week Supplementation of Ashwagandha and B-Vitamins on Mood and Stress Relief
records.population_preparation_and_design: 40 women used mixed taffy in uncontrolled four-week pre/post study.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Stress/anxiety scores fell; cortisol/amylase unchanged.
records.uncertainty: No control and no muscle endpoint.

records.title: Muscle metabolism during prolonged exercise in humans: influence of carbohydrate availability.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Eight trained men in randomized crossover CHO vs sweet placebo.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Cycling-to-exhaustion time increased about 30%.
records.uncertainty: Small trained-male acute study.

records.title: The effect of a lidocaine test dose on analgesia and mobility after an epidural combination of neostigmine and sufentanil in early labor.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 80 parturients randomized to lidocaine or saline test dose before same epidural combination.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Lidocaine changed analgesia and reduced ambulation; procedural interaction only.
records.uncertainty: Not a general muscle medicine result.

records.title: A Novel Honey Powder-Based Supplement Containing Carbohydrate and Protein Did Not Improve Endurance Performance in Recreationally Trained Cyclists.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 12 male cyclists in placebo-controlled crossover.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: 20-minute work/power similar; secondary measures differed.
records.uncertainty: Small acute study; primary null.

records.title: Efficacy and safety of Latilactobacillus curvatus LB-P9 on hair health: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 80 adults randomized to LB-P9 or placebo for 24 weeks.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Hair luster/elasticity improved; no muscle/locomotor result.
records.uncertainty: Off-target tissue.

records.title: [Network Meta-analysis of Chinese patent medicine in treatment of heart failure with preserved ejection fraction].
records.population_preparation_and_design: Network synthesis of 74 RCTs and 11 medicine products.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Some walk-test results reported; evidence quality limited.
records.uncertainty: Review, not new study.

records.title: No ergogeniceffect of β-alanine on repeated sprint ability: a systematic review and multilevel meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Review of 17 RCTs.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: No pooled repeated-sprint or fatigue benefit.
records.uncertainty: Review only.

records.title: The physiological effects of caffeine in women during treadmill walking.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 20 women tested placebo and 3/6 mg/kg caffeine while walking.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: High dose altered VO2/energy use; RPE/HR/RER unchanged; no performance gain.
records.uncertainty: Physiological response, not improved function.

records.title: Dietary nitrate supplementation increases acute mountain sickness severity and sense of effort during hypoxic exercise.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 20 active men in crossover of nitrate juice/placebo after five days.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: No exercise benefit; headache/AMS increased in susceptible participants.
records.uncertainty: Hypoxia-specific small study.

records.title: Supplemental prophylactic intervention for chemotherapy-induced nausea and emesis (SPICE) trial: Protocol for a multicentre double-blind placebo-controlled randomised trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Protocol for standardized gingerol adjunct during chemotherapy.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Protocol only.
records.uncertainty: No result.

records.title: Caffeine improves muscular performance in elite Brazilian Jiu-jitsu athletes.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 14 men in crossover of 3 mg/kg caffeine/placebo.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Grip, jump, static-lift and bench measures improved.
records.uncertainty: Small acute athlete study.

records.title: Dietary pectin influences fibrin network structure in hypercholesterolaemic subjects.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 20 hyperlipidemic men randomized to pectin or placebo for four weeks.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Lipids/fibrin-network changed; no function endpoint.
records.uncertainty: Biomarker only.

records.title: Effects of Collagen Hydrolysate-Based Protein Complexes on Physical Endurance, Glucose Metabolism, and Renal Function in Rats
records.population_preparation_and_design: 90 rats given four complex mixtures or control for 40 days.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Forced-swim endurance rose from baseline; treatment-control contrast unclear.
records.uncertainty: Animal, mixture, ambiguous comparator.

records.title: PD-1 blockade in recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer: Data from cemiplimab phase I expansion cohorts and characterization of PD-L1 expression in cervical cancer.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Nonrandomized phase-I monotherapy or radiation-combination cancer cohorts.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Tumor response/biomarker outcomes; no muscle function.
records.uncertainty: Off-scope for muscle; not BUB1B/MVA evidence.

records.title: Effects of chronic Rhodiola Rosea supplementation on sport performance and antioxidant capacity in trained male: preliminary results.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 14 trained men compared four-week Rhodiola and placebo periods.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Exercise duration/VO2 unchanged; lactate/CK lower.
records.uncertainty: Preliminary, small; biomarker change without performance.

records.title: Decrease in respiratory quotient during exercise following L-carnitine supplementation.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 10 trained adults in crossover after 2 g/day L-carnitine/placebo periods.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Respiratory quotient fell; no performance endpoint.
records.uncertainty: Metabolic only.

records.title: Treatment with L-Citrulline in patients with post-polio syndrome: A single center, randomized, double blind, placebo-controlled trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 29 patients randomized to 15 g/day L-citrulline/placebo for 24 weeks.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Six-minute walk and secondary motor/strength/MRI results nonsignificant.
records.uncertainty: Small neuromuscular human functional null.

records.title: Efficacy of iron supplementation on physical capacity in non-anaemic iron-deficient individuals: protocol for an individual patient data meta-analysis.
records.population_preparation_and_design: Protocol for IPD synthesis of oral/IV iron studies.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: No pooled result; function/fatigue planned.
records.uncertainty: Protocol only.

records.title: Effects of ingestion of bicarbonate, citrate, lactate, and chloride on sprint running.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 15 men in randomized crossover buffer comparison.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Run-to-exhaustion favored bicarbonate; practical estimates uncertain.
records.uncertainty: Small acute trial and modeled time-trial comparison.

records.title: How Supplementation with SOD-Rich Plant Extract, Combined with Gliadin, Can Affect Oxidative Stress Markers and Zonulin Levels in Exercise-Induced Oxidative Stress.
records.role: SOD-rich plant extract plus gliadin in rowers
records.population_preparation_and_design: 30 rowers randomized to mixture/control for six weeks.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Markers and reported metabolic efficiency improved; absolute power contrast needs full report.
records.uncertainty: Mixture and surrogate efficiency.

records.title: The impact of ecbolic therapy in the early postpartum period on uterine involution and reproductive health in dairy cows.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 118 cows randomized to oxytocin, dinoprost or saline after calving.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: No uterine/reproductive benefit.
records.uncertainty: Veterinary reproductive evidence, not muscle.

records.title: Montmorency tart cherry juice does not reduce markers of muscle soreness, function and inflammation following professional male rugby League match-play.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 11 professional players compared cherry juice/placebo around matches.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: No difference in soreness, jump, sleep/fatigue or cytokines.
records.uncertainty: Very small match study.

records.title: Efficacy of UC-II® Undenatured Type II Collagen on Knee Joint Function in Healthy Subjects: an Exploratory Post Hoc Analysis of a Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Trial
records.population_preparation_and_design: Age-50+ subset of 17 from prior placebo-controlled 120-day trial.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Selected KOOS items favored UC-II.
records.uncertainty: Post-hoc/preprint and parent-trial link need confirmation.

records.title: Effects of daily protein intake frequency during 8 weeks of resistance training on lean mass and strength adaptations: a randomized non-controlled clinical trial.
records.population_preparation_and_design: 32 young men randomized to three versus five protein meals; 18 completed.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Both arms improved; no difference in strength/mass.
records.uncertainty: No nonprotein control and substantial noncompletion.

records.title: The Effect of Tribulus Terrestris Supplementation on Inflammation, Oxidative Stress and Performance of Recreational Runners: Study Protocol for a Double-Blind Randomized Controlled Trial
records.population_preparation_and_design: Preprint protocol for Tribulus vs placebo during two-week HIIT.
records.functional_endpoint_and_contrast: Protocol only.
records.uncertainty: No efficacy results.
